title: BAGMAN Canonical Identifier
description: BAGMAN's opaque, canonical internal identifier. A lowercase UUIDv7 string (RFC 9562): standard 8-4-4-4-12 lowercase hexadecimal UUID string form, with the version nibble (first hex digit of the 3rd group) fixed to `7` and the variant nibble (first hex digit of the 4th group) constrained to one of `8`, `9`, `a`, `b`. This identifier is: opaque (carries no business meaning), immutable once assigned, non-secret, safe to write to logs, safe to use in URLs, and independent of any external-provider identifier (see PID §5). It is used as the canonical `*_id` field on every BAGMAN domain object (GovernedEntity, EvidenceItem, Source, ExternalReference, Provenance, AuditEvent, etc.) via `$ref` from this schema. It must never be derived from a mutable business value (invoice number, email address, supplier name, filename, bank reference, customer name).
